facts.fact: The Council of Ministers (98th meeting, 11 September 2026) validated a bill authorising ratification of the ordonnance-loi organising statistical activity, submitted by the Plan minister; the document gives no promulgation or commencement date for the ordonnance-loi itself.

note: Only the ratification bill is dated; the ordonnance-loi's own in-force date and any rules or acts under it are not stated, so no in-force or reach fact.

facts.fact: UNFPA DRC says a statistics law bill was drafted in December 2024 by the National Institute of Statistics with UNFPA support and the government should still have the National Assembly adopt it.

The Senate ratified unanimously of those voting (73 of 109 senators) ordonnance-loi n° 26/015 of 7 September 2026 organising statistical activity, a 95-article text presented by Vice-Prime Minister Guyllain Nyembo that sets the institutional framework and provides sanctions for breaches of statistical secrecy.
ACP reports the DR Congo President took ordonnance-loi n° 26/015 of 7 September 2026 organising statistical activity, which the Senate voted to ratify on 21 October 2026, 73 of 73 votes in favour.
